notes: Built once from settings and the strategy, clock and seating components: createComputers(settings, {strategy, clock, seating}). SeatingState, game clock state (ClockState) and observations are opaque here. Clock times are milliseconds on the action clock; wall times are epoch milliseconds. The derived values settings.enabled (mode is not none), settings.fillEmptySeats (mode is fill-empty) and settings.takeOverAbsent (same as enabled) are on the object createComputers returns.

settings.names: string list, or one text separated by spaces or commas (the installer setting is space separated; its grammar allows no comma); the names computers sit under, in order; neutral defaults ship
settings.mode: string, none | on-request | fill-empty, default on-request. none: no computer is seated (add is refused with notAllowed, fill adds none, nobody plays for an absent person). on-request: a person adds one, and a computer plays for a person who is away or sitting out. fill-empty: as on-request and fill() seats computers until the table is full
settings.thinkSpreadMs: integer, default 1200; thinking time is thinkMinMs plus a random share of this
settings.minimumGapMs: integer, default 4000; a computer never moves sooner than this after now
settings.rebuyDelayMs: integer, default 4000; delay before a computer accepts a rebuy

idFor.returns: string (stable player id for a computer name)

add.returns: Outcome (notAllowed when enabled is false or seating refuses; seating's roomFull; roomFull also when every name is taken)

wakeAt.returns: number (wall time the deadline falls due)

rebuyAt.returns: number (action-clock time a computer accepts a rebuy offered now)

parseNames.returns: string[] (split on spaces and commas; empty and repeated entries dropped)
